author: D4S
name: DDD aggregate (domain model, persistence, migration, endpoints, tests)
description: Adds a tactical-DDD aggregate to the starter: identifier, state enum, command and event hierarchies, aggregate root, repository interface, EF Core configuration and repository, SQL migration script, HAL endpoint module and domain tests. Run from the repository root.

plural.description: PascalCase plural of the aggregate (repository type, endpoint names, route segment, table name). Defaults to a naive pluralisation of the name: Todo -> Todos, City -> Cities.

migration-version.description: Version prefix of the generated SQL migration script (Vnnnn). Must be the next free, unique number in src/App.Infrastructure/Migrations: SqlMigratorTests rejects duplicates.

postActions.description: Wiring steps that dotnet new cannot perform (design section 12).

manualInstructions.text:
Two steps that dotnet new cannot inject. The example below is spelled for `-n Todo`;
substitute the name you actually passed (and its plural: <Name>s by default, or the --plural you gave).

1. src/App.Infrastructure/InfrastructureServiceCollectionExtensions.cs
     add   using App.Domain.Todo;
     add   services.AddScoped<ITodos, Todos>();   inside AddPersistence, next to the other repositories.

2. src/App.Infrastructure/Migrations/V0003__add_todos.sql
     the script is embedded automatically (Migrations/*.sql) and applied by SqlMigrator, but the version
     number is a guess: rename the file to the next free Vnnnn in that folder (or generate with
     --migration-version V0004). SqlMigratorTests requires the Vnnnn__lower_snake_case shape and a unique Vnnnn prefix.
     Review the columns against TodoConfiguration and add a CREATE INDEX per HasIndex; SchemaValidationTests
     diffs the database against the EF model.

Nothing else needs registering: the endpoint module (IEndpointModule) is found by MapApi(), the EF mapping
(IEntityTypeConfiguration<T>) by ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(), and the EF converter for TodoId by the
value-object convention (RegisterDomainValueObjects) — identifiers need no persistence code at all.

Then:  dotnet build -warnaserror  &&  dotnet test
